_comment: The Vana Personal Server's composed PDPP AS + RS. RUN AND VERIFIED.
The target is the MERGE of two branches, because neither alone can serve it:
- waspflow/pdpp-integrated-journey-0917 (6e5ff0d) has the AS and the
authorization journey this adapter drives.
- feat/pdpp-record-storage-rs (8ba3265, PR #328) has the RS fixes for
unknown query parameters and malformed cursors, but DELETES the AS
(no routes/pdpp-auth.ts, no pdpp/bootstrap.ts), so the journey cannot
run against it on its own.
Merge 8ba3265 into 6e5ff0d; two conflicts in routes/pdpp-records{,.test}.ts
resolve by taking the RS branch's rejectUnknownParams and keeping the
integration branch's PDPP_API_VERSION (both constants are '2026-04-06').
Boot (from a personal-server-ts checkout at that merge):
1. npm install --allow-git=root --ignore-scripts
2. npm install-scripts approve better-sqlite3 esbuild secp256k1  (native builds)
3. npm rebuild better-sqlite3 secp256k1 esbuild
4. (cd packages/core && npm run build)
5. boot via createServer + listenHttpServer with pdpp.enabled, a declaration
file, a pre-registered client whose redirect_uri matches exactly, a
data_files scope row, and VANA_MASTER_KEY_SIGNATURE set.
See local/conformance-fleet-0917/handoff/LIVE-BOOT.md for the recipe this
follows; the composed branch additionally mounts the RS.
ownerBootstrapToken is the server's dev token, printed at boot. It changes per
boot, so replace it each time rather than trusting the value below.
This deployment is CO-LOCATED (one origin) and uses a session-based journey
(authorize -> review -> approve -> PKCE code exchange) rather than the
reference's RFC 9126 PAR + consent route. Core pins neither: Section 6 defines
the selection request and Section 7 the resolved grant, not the route between
them. Both are conformant, and the case bodies never see the difference.
Two deployment facts that are configuration, not findings:
- /pdpp/v1/revoke takes form encoding, not JSON (as do /token and
/introspect); the consent endpoints take JSON.
- one owner is bound to the server, so there is no second subject. RS-12
reports skip naming that rather than passing on no evidence.
Declare BOTH streams below in the boot declaration and give each a data_files
scope row, then seed both. The stream-membership oracles (RS-2 enforcement,
RS-6 error classification) work by holding one stream OUT of the grant, so a
single-stream deployment can only report skip on them. Seed several records
into top_artists as well: a stream too short to produce a page cursor cannot
exercise the cursor/changes_since token-space separation case.
Run: tsx src/cli.ts --target targets/vana-personal-server.json
